Practical paths · Free

Eight directions.
Your starting point.

Choose a direction and work through three guided practices, with space to write what you notice.

Clarity

Name the real decision, separate facts from guesses and define a useful result.

This selector previews the paths. Your journal and saved progress stay in the app.

Decisions · Free

A plan
you can revisit.

Write the decision, the result you want and your next action. Start the plan, then compare it with what actually happened.

Decision plans work without an account or Plus. Your choices and observed outcomes remain separate from astrology-based interpretation.

Your journal · Free

Keep the lesson.
See what changed.

Save reflections, practice records and takeaways in your journal. Return to earlier entries when the next decision takes shape.

Your journal is stored on this device. Signing in does not upload your notes or automatically sync them to another iPhone or iPad.

Personal Today · Coming in the next update

Your day,
in perspective.

Read a short daily message and previews for Business, Friends, Family and Love. Revisit earlier days of the current Monday-to-today week.

Plus opens detailed readings and explanations of the calculated transits behind them. Record your own “Accurate” or “Not accurate” feedback locally.

Requires an account and a local birth profile. The screen shows the guest starting point. Once you sign in and add your profile, opening Today prepares your reading.

More perspective with Plus · Coming in the next update

Give your plans
room to breathe.

Sign in and add your birth profile. Open a personal reading to begin; detailed readings, Outlook and Compass require Plus.

Outlook

A week or a month ahead

Explore structured reflections for the current week or month. See the calculated snapshot behind each reading and use it alongside your real plans and observations.

Compass

Think through a question

Explicitly send a question or decision to the AI with calculated profile context and a short conversation history. Your journal is not attached automatically, and the conversation is not saved to your journal.

Your profile

A context you control

Edit or remove your optional birth profile in Settings. Your journal stays separate, and its entries are not attached to personal readings automatically.

Astrological snapshots support reflection. They do not promise event dates, successful decisions or guaranteed results.

Optional birth profile · Free

Explore your
personal context.

Calculate your astrology profile, natal chart, numerology, Chinese zodiac and archetype on your device. Explore the chart and current transits without paying for Plus.

Unknown birth time is supported, with clearly limited detail. Raw birth inputs are stored separately from your journal. Edit or delete the profile in Settings.

Calculated chart · Free

See the geometry
behind the context.

Explore current transits alongside your natal chart. Astronomy is calculated on the device, separately from the interpretation offered in the upcoming update.

Available details depend on the accuracy of your birth information. The chart shown uses an example profile.
